name: aquatek-sailfish-16x9-timeline-anchor
notes: Follow-up to aquatek-sailfish-16x9-reframecache, which still showed text/logo distortion despite the cuts-capped guidance. Testing Mark De Castro's timeline-ref-anchor hypothesis (see timeline-ref-anchor-pelagic.json) adapted to our product: bind each of the 3 reference images to a specific time segment instead of letting the model blend all refs freely across 10s. Pelagic Gear 'Aquatek Sailfish Mind', Slate. Production-representative refs (useReframeCache). 16:9, 10s.

variants.guidance:
Timeline (10s):
- 0.0-3.0s: Anchor to IMAGE 1 (the product-only hero). Camera holds on the product as shown in IMAGE 1. Match its framing, lighting, and every printed mark, wordmark, and label exactly as they appear in IMAGE 1. On-garment text remains spelled as in IMAGE 1 for this entire segment.
- 3.0-7.0s: Transition to IMAGE 2's staging. Framing matches IMAGE 2. On-garment text remains as spelled in IMAGE 2 — do not re-render or resubstitute letters, wordmarks, or tags. Motion may include a slow push; text region stays stable.
- 7.0-10.0s: Close-up detail matching IMAGE 3's framing. Text and prints on the product remain as spelled in IMAGE 3 for this segment; do not introduce any letter, digit, or logo not visible in IMAGE 3.
